senses.gloss: f. (cmp. קִשְׁבָּא) date of a certain species, kothebeth, used as a measure of size כַּכֹּ׳ (cmp. זַיִת).
units: Bets. I, 1 חמץ בְּכַכֹּ׳ the standard for leavened bread (on Passover, as for being guilty of a transgression) is the size of a kothebeth (less than an olive); a. fr.—Pl. כּוֹתָבוֹת.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 2:5">Succ. II, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 26b:10">26ᵇ</cite>) <he>שתי כ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="U01585"><he>שני</he></cite>) two dates.
